Sam is interested in reading. Tom is reading a book about science. Both of them like bread and coffee. For example, she ironed his shirt for the interview.
Tom drinks coffee after doing sports. The weather was cloudy that day. Tom thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. They offered store credit instead.
They took many photos at the corner store. Tom hopes to visit Paris one day. The pedestrian street is one of the best places in the city.
